sql-7:

    score,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY score DESC) AS rank
FROM Scores

sql-8:
SELECT DISTINCT l1.num AS ConsecutiveNums
FROM Logs l1
JOIN Logs l2 ON l1.id = l2.id - 1
JOIN Logs l3 ON l1.id = l3.id - 2
WHERE l1.num = l2.num AND l2.num = l3.num;
sql-9:

FROM Employee e

sql-12:
SELECT d.name AS Department, e.name AS Employee, e.salary AS Salary
FROM Employee e
JOIN Department d ON e.departmentId = d.id
WHERE e.salary = (
  SELECT MAX(e2.salary)
  FROM Employee e2
  WHERE e2.departmentId = e.departmentId
);
sql-13:
SELECT w1.id
FROM Weather w1
JOIN Weather w2
  ON w1.recordDate = DATE_ADD(w2.recordDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
WHERE w1.temperature > w2.temperature;
sql-15:
WITH first_login AS (
    SELECT player_id, MIN(event_date) AS first_date
    FROM Activity
    GROUP BY player_id
),
next_day_login AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.player_id
    FROM first_login f
    JOIN Activity a ON f.player_id = a.player_id
    AND a.event_date = DATE_ADD(f.first_date, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
)
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT n.player_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.player_id), 2) AS fraction
FROM first_login f
LEFT JOIN next_day_login n ON f.player_id = n.player_id;
sql-16:

FROM Employee e
JOIN (
    SELECT managerId
    FROM Employee
    WHERE managerId IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY managerId

sql-17:

FROM Employee e
LEFT JOIN Bonus b ON e.empId = b.empId

sql-19:

FROM Insurance
WHERE tiv_2015 IN (
    SELECT tiv_2015
    FROM Insurance
    GROUP BY tiv_2015
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)

    SELECT lat, lon
    FROM Insurance
    GROUP BY lat, lon
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
);

sql-26:
SELECT 
    id,
    CASE 
        WHEN p_id IS NULL THEN 'Root'
        WHEN id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT p_id FROM Tree WHERE p_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Leaf'
        ELSE 'Inner'
    END AS type
FROM Tree
ORDER BY id;

  SUM(CASE WHEN month = 'Feb' THEN revenue END) AS Feb_Revenue,

    p.product_id,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p.price * u.units) / NULLIF(SUM(u.units), 0), 0), 2) AS average_price

sql-48:

    s.student_id,
    s.student_name,
    sub.subject_name,
    COUNT(e.subject_name) AS attended_exams
FROM Students s
CROSS JOIN Subjects sub
LEFT JOIN Examinations e
    ON s.student_id = e.student_id AND sub.subject_name = e.subject_name

ORDER BY s.student_id, sub.subject_name;
sql-49:
WITH daily_totals AS (
    SELECT visited_on,
           SUM(amount) AS amount
    FROM Customer
    GROUP BY visited_on
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT visited_on,
           amount,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY visited_on) AS rn,
           SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS sum_7,
           AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY visited_on ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_7
    FROM daily_totals
)
SELECT visited_on,
       sum_7 AS amount,
       ROUND(avg_7, 2) AS average_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn >= 7
ORDER BY visited_on;
sql-50:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(o.unit) AS unit
FROM Products p
JOIN Orders o ON p.product_id = o.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2020-02-01' AND o.order_date < '2020-03-01'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
HAVING SUM(o.unit) >= 100;
sql-51:
WITH user_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        u.name,
        COUNT(*) AS rating_count
    FROM MovieRating mr
    JOIN Users u ON mr.user_id = u.user_id
    GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name
),
top_user AS (
    SELECT name
    FROM user_ratings
    ORDER BY rating_count DESC, name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
feb_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        m.title,
        AVG(mr.rating) AS avg_rating
    FROM MovieRating mr
    JOIN Movies m ON mr.movie_id = m.movie_id
    WHERE mr.created_at >= '2020-02-01' AND mr.created_at < '2020-03-01'
    GROUP BY m.movie_id, m.title
),
top_movie AS (
    SELECT title
    FROM feb_movies
    ORDER BY avg_rating DESC, title ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT name AS results FROM top_user
UNION ALL
SELECT title AS results FROM top_movie;

sql-60:
SELECT 
  a1.machine_id,
  ROUND(AVG(a2.timestamp - a1.timestamp), 3) AS processing_time
FROM Activity a1
JOIN Activity a2
  ON a1.machine_id = a2.machine_id
  AND a1.process_id = a2.process_id
  AND a1.activity_type = 'start'
  AND a2.activity_type = 'end'
GROUP BY a1.machine_id;
